exposure: C-reactive protein level on postoperative day 3
cohort: 377 patients who underwent total laparoscopic hysterectomy at the Saitama Medical Center, Saitama Medical University, Japan between January 1, 2015 and December 31, 2019
finding: Only the C-reactive protein level on postoperative day 3 was significantly correlated with SSI after total laparoscopic hysterectomy.
